title: com.cancel arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

request.description: A request the caller's Project sent; only the sender Project may cancel it.

expectedRevision.description: The request revision the caller last read; another one is revision_conflict.
